rationale: We landed on the Moncler homepage with no product tiles, likely due to locale/cookie gates and a non-PLP entry URL. The patch enforces the en-gb locale, adds robust OneTrust cookie handling, seeds a stable PLP URL, and broadens PLP/PDP selectors to match Moncler’s components. URL normalization avoids locale traps and external monclergroup.com redirects, increasing the chance of immediately seeing product tiles and collecting PDP links and prices.
code_hints: On first load, race two waits: cookie banner and PLP tiles. If '#onetrust-accept-btn-handler' appears, click it, then re-wait for 'li[data-testid="product-tile"]'.
If current URL host != 'www.moncler.com' or locale prefix not '/en-gb/', rebuild URL to enforce https://www.moncler.com/en-gb/ + original path and navigate there.
If you land on the homepage or any page without product tiles after 6–8 seconds, navigate directly to the seeded PLP: /en-gb/men/ready-to-wear/down-jackets/.
For lazy-loaded PLPs, scroll incrementally (e.g., 1000–1500px steps, 300–500ms delay) until either at least 24 product tiles are present or no growth after 2 scrolls.
Extract PDP links from the closest anchor within the product tile; prefer 'a[data-testid="product-tile-link"]', else the first descendant 'a[href*="/en-gb/"]'. De-duplicate by pathname.
On PDP, try price selectors in order: [data-testid='pdp-price'] -> [itemprop='price'] -> '.pdp [class*="Price"]'. Normalize currency by reading 'content' or 'data-*' attributes if present.
If a locale/country modal appears, try a generic close: 'button[aria-label="Close"]' or '[data-testid="close-modal"]'. If a region selection CTA exists, prefer links that contain '/en-gb/'.
Abort or skip any navigation that redirects to monclergroup.com or changes locale away from en-gb.
